note: NOT a competition result and not poolable with one. Six extra runs of the five-season competition on six arbitrary week grids (warmupDays 29-34, anchorMonday off), measured only to establish how far the paired record against thoughtful-human wanders when the grid is moved for no reason. Strategy names carry a @warmup<n> suffix so verdict.ts keeps each grid in its own group rather than summing six overlapping experiments. Confound worth naming: warmupDays sets both the grid offset and how much history the model holds in week one, so these grids differ by up to six days of prior stats as well as by phase.
